# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.60

## Fixed

- Project Control option 25 now writes and verifies NSSM's native multi-string
  service environment directly, correcting activation failures caused by
  command-line serialization of `AppEnvironmentExtra`.

## Safety

- Restores remain isolated and retain dump, migration, runtime-role, business
  fingerprint, executable, process, listener, database, and one-time health
  verification.
- No schema migration, business-data rewrite, production GUI restore change,
  or proxy, Kasm, Cloudflare, CORS, cookie, or HTTPS configuration change.
